bcMediaHeaderLiesAboutTheCodec: Every I/P packet of this hub child declares "H264" in its BcMedia header while the payload is H.265. detectVideoCodecFromNal is what gets it right.
sanitised: Every BcMedia header is the captured wire, byte for byte. AAC: the 7-byte ADTS header of each frame is kept, the 512 compressed bytes after it are zeroed.
